chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Umar ibn Jabala al-Ahmasi, from Abu al-Jaroud, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The ones who love for the sake of Allah on the Day of Resurrection will be upon a land of green emerald, in the shade of His Throne, by His right hand, and both of His hands are right. Their faces will be whiter and more luminous than the rising sun. Every near angel and every sent prophet will envy them for their status. The people will say, 'Who are these?' So it will be said, 'These are the ones who loved for the sake of Allah.'

key_terms.الْمُتَحَابُّونَ فِي اللَّهِ: The ones who love each other for the sake of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is the status of those who love for the sake of Allah on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This hadith, found in al-Kafi, elaborates on the concept of *al-wala' wa al-bar'* (loyalty and disavement) by highlighting the spiritual rank of those whose bonds are rooted exclusively in divine love. It emphasizes their unique proximity to the Divine Throne (*'Arsh*) on the Day of Judgment, where their radiant countenance and elevated status are recognized by all creation, including prophets and angels. This narrative underscores the Shia understanding that mutual love for Allah's sake is a tangible sign of true faith and a means of attaining high eschatological honor.
